title: Projection-normalized composition comparison on enlarged etale sites
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and use algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and sheaves on their small and enlarged etale sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]. For composable maps $W\xrightarrow{g}X\xrightarrow{f}Y$, let $v_f$ be the enlarged-site base-change functor. Define $v_g\circ v_f\simeq v_{fg}$ on each object by the fibre-product pasting isomorphism preserving both projections [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. For a category $\mathcal A$ of coefficients, define $f_*g_*\simeq(fg)_*$ on enlarged-site $\mathcal A$-valued sheaves by evaluating a sheaf contravariantly on this site comparison. No associativity, localization, or ringed-map coherence theorem is asserted.
